claim_boundary: These records preserve reviewer summaries, exact URLs, and source-status metadata. Versionless pages were not content-snapshotted, remain mutable, and supply no ZenoProof theorem or deployment premise.

sources.name: Boundless Proving Node v2.0 release
sources.exact_observation: The release note reports removal of an approximately 30% cluster database penalty, approximately 99.6% predecessor lock fulfillment, and 25 ZKC slashed after two predecessor failures.
sources.use_in_packet: Operational report that motivates modeling software contention and collateral loss as proof-supply variables; a collateral-driven exit response remains an inference.

sources.name: Proo-phi v5

sources.use_in_packet: Narrow theorem comparator; no theorem is transferred to ZenoProof.
